name: Hornero System Health
description: System Health 2.0: dashboard health summary over the shared PluginKit System, Power and Network facades, with per-row health states, thresholds and troubleshooting hints. No invented SMART data.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Health summary on the shared System/Power/Network facades: per-row health states from typed thresholds, troubleshooting hints, honest unavailable states and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card summarising CPU, memory, storage, battery and network with honest unavailable states.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a CPU, memory or storage row needs attention.

batteryWarnPercent.description: Battery percent at or below which a discharging battery needs attention.

showNetwork.description: Show the download/upload rows from the Network service (the 1.x behaviour).

showHints.description: Show a short troubleshooting hint under rows that need attention.
